arStrings.szText: Welcome! Season Rank is an overview of the challenges that await you during each season.

To complete each Rank, you'll need to finish a challenging activity, usually a {icon:Icon_Tooltip_Dungeon_Capstone,1.8} {c_capstone}Capstone Dungeon{/c}. {c_highlight}You may attempt the Capstone earlier than the recommended level.{/c}

Prepare yourself for these challenges by completing {icon:Rank_IconsBarMap_Objetives, 2}{c_highlight} Bonus Objectives{/c} in each Rank to earn rewards such as {icon:Rank_IconsBarMap_AbilityPoints, 2} {c_highlight}Ability Points{/c}, {icon:Rank_IconsBarMap_SmolderingAshes, 2} {c_highlight}Smoldering Ashes{/c}, and {icon:Rank_IconsBarMap_Cosmetics, 2} {c_highlight}Cosmetics{/c}!
